description: This file defines interfaces related to stream checkpointing in Orleans, including a factory interface for creating checkpointers and a generic interface for checkpoint operations such as load and update.

classes.name: IStreamQueueCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating stream queue checkpointer instances for specific partitions.

classes.name: IStreamQueueCheckpointer<TCheckpoint>
classes.description: Generic interface defining checkpointing operations such as checking existence, loading, and updating checkpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a stream checkpointer for a given partition.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint with a new offset and current UTC time.
